title: Colosseum 1.1.2
summary: Vault's file tracking is hardened and gets a home portal, Watch Party ships on by default with auto-fetching joins, Tankoban gets a Library tab, and Biblio's catalogue is rebuilt underneath Discover and Explore.

highlights.title: Hardened, with a home portal
highlights.body: Live deletion and replacement reconcile instantly, stale enrichment can no longer overwrite newer data, and CBR fails closed. A new home portal opens Vault from Colosseum's home screen.

highlights.title: On by default
highlights.body: Watch Party points at a hosted relay out of the box. Joining a room now fetches that room's exact source automatically.

highlights.title: Library tab
highlights.body: A fourth tab, Library, gives the volumes you already own a dedicated home next to Discover.

highlights.title: Catalogue overhaul
highlights.body: New Open Library providers, expanded ranking, and a reworked catalogue store sit underneath Discover and Explore.

highlights.title: ScrollGlide and the chronicle
highlights.body: Grid surfaces carry scroll momentum instead of snapping, and the Update page's chronicle view moved to the top bar, full-bleed.
